name: Gazlowe's Ledger
summary: In Ratchet, Gazlowe checks his trade records against the harbor manifest when a shipment from Booty Bay goes missing.

sections.title: Ratchet's Commercial Records
sections.body: Gazlowe tracks trade goods in Ratchet with a personal ledger. It records imported crates, outbound cargo, and warehouse stores. When a shipment from Booty Bay is missing, Gazlowe compares his expected inventory with the dock records kept by Wharfmaster Dizzywig.

sections.title: Uncovering the Theft
sections.body: Gazlowe and the other goblins compare the ledger with Dizzywig's harbor logs and find that the cargo never reached the port warehouse. The mismatch confirms Gazlowe's suspicion that the crates were taken before they came ashore. The Southsea Freebooters along the nearby Merchant Coast are to blame.

faq.answer: Gazlowe's Ledger records goods expected and stored in Ratchet. Gazlowe sends it to the docks so its entries can be checked against the wharf records when a shipment is missing.

faq.q: Who needs to inspect the ledger?
aliases: who do i take the ledger to
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Dizzywig reviews Gazlowe's Ledger against his shipping logs. He oversees the Ratchet docks and can determine whether missing goods were misplaced or never unloaded.

faq.q: What cargo was missing in the ledger?
faq.answer: Gazlowe was waiting for his latest shipment from Booty Bay. Dizzywig finds nothing amiss in his logs, though he says goods from Undermine are waiting for Gazlowe to pick up.

faq.q: What happens after the ledger is checked?
faq.answer: Dizzywig checks whether the shipment passed through the docks. When he finds it did not, the ledger goes back to Gazlowe, confirming that Southsea Freebooters likely intercepted the cargo at sea.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can trade at Ratchet, a neutral port. Helping Gazlowe trace stolen shipments keeps good standing with the local Steamwheedle authorities.
As a rogue, you can glimpse the flow of contraband, valuable imports, and piracy around the Barrens coast in a goblin boss's private trade ledger.
